description: Machine-checkable per-source rights gate for the Sacred-History Corpus. Codifies SOURCES.md + the ADOPTED (founder D2, 2026-05-19) RIGHTS-POLICY.md two-tier gate. Every ingestion runner and downstream tool MUST classify an edition against this file BEFORE writing any bytes. Absent an unambiguous PD/open license, a source is metadata-only (Tier B). This file does NOT remove any live guard; tier_b_guard stays on.

policy.tier_a: FULL-TEXT allowed — public-domain OR openly licensed (CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA/PD-dedication/explicit free-use grant by the rights holder). Stores full normalized text + addressing + witness base + a license field naming the exact instrument + URL.
policy.tier_b: CITATION + LOCATOR ONLY — copyrighted and not openly licensed, OR NC, OR unclear. Stores title/publisher/year/edition-id, translator/holder, license=all-rights-reserved (or the NC instrument), a stable locator scheme, a canonical_citation string, an optional deep link, and bucket's own brief description. NEVER any passage text, NEVER cached source pages, NEVER a reconstruction.
policy.nc_posture: NC (CC-BY-NC / CC-BY-NC-SA) is treated as Tier B / metadata-only for bucket's potentially-commercial posture. Promotion to Tier A requires a documented nonprofit-only contractual clearance logged in CORPUS_INDEX.md.
policy.manuscript_images: ALWAYS excluded. Image bytes are never stored regardless of source. Manuscript rows record shelfmark, holding institution, IIIF/permalink, and provenance claims only. A diplomatic transcription may be Tier A ONLY if it carries its own named PD/open license.
policy.fair_use_micro_quote: A single contested word or short phrase may appear ONLY inside a claims/ object, ONLY when the claim is about that exact rendering, with rights.basis='fair-use-criticism'. Never reconstructs a passage. When in doubt, leave it out.
policy.per_item_rule: Per-item sources must read the upstream per-item license field at fetch time and fall back to metadata-only on absence or on any NC/copyright reading.
policy.coi_guard: Any ingestion touching a rights holder AGFarms/founder has a commercial relationship with is flagged coi_review=true and held in _intake/ until cleared (GOVERNANCE.md §7 arms-length).
policy.immutability: A node's tier is immutable without an explicit rights re-review logged in CORPUS_INDEX.md with date + evidence.

live_guard.note: PD/open Phase-1 sources are LIVE. Tier-B (copyrighted/NC/unclear) stays GATED (tier_b_guard=1). Delivering this file does NOT flip tier_b_guard.
